items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I don't remember. I see, had Myner Sinski come to town with him? Myner?

ctx.x: Yeah. There was, there was some guy named John Myner who took photographs. Years later, I discovered we're at the same party by looking at the photographs.
